name: Motion for a resolution
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the case of Abdoul Aziz Goma, arbitrarily detained in Togo
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and calling for action. It condemns Togo's detention and torture of Abdoul Aziz Goma, an Irish-Togolese man held since 2018 and sentenced to 10 years in 2025. It asks Togo to release him at once, cancel his conviction, let him get urgent medical care abroad, and free all political prisoners. It also asks the European Union to press the case through diplomacy and to help strengthen courts and the rule of law in Togo.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. This is the Parliament's opinion and a set of requests, not a law.
- **Who it affects:** Abdoul Aziz Goma, other prisoners in Togo, and Togo's government.
- **What happens next:** The text goes to European Union bodies and Togo's government. Togo decides whether to act.
